slyde.jfconfig.title: Slyde
slyde.jfconfig.sodiumCompat.tooltip: If sodium is installed, modify its slider widget as well
slyde.jfconfig.forceSodiumCompat.tooltip: Attempt to modify sodium's slider widget even if sodium is not detected
slyde.jfconfig.holdKeyToActivate.tooltip:
Require holding Shift or Ctrl to drag sliders further than intended.
If false, Shift and Ctrl will disable the extended dragging instead.
slyde.jfconfig.mouseLock: Acquire mouse lock when dragging sliders
slyde.jfconfig.mouseLock.tooltip: This allows you to drag sliders even further since it avoids the screen edge stopping the mouse.
